name: case2_multi
goal: Case 2 phone scanner, several parcels (up to 3), one after another: the phone in the left claw scans a label; the harness routes it; the right arm picks THAT parcel (head-camera label with the same pincode, else the one nearest the phone's aim) where the head camera sees it; WALLX carries it into the scanned zone; then the next parcel, until the head camera sees none left on the table. Each round needs a new scan (a parcel already sorted never counts again). One parcel works too: it goes home after the first.
setup: Phone (scanner page, Start camera) ready; 2-3 labelled parcels, labels up, on the middle / right half of the table, about 10 cm apart, each label different; arms at rest. The phone scans the parcel nearest where it points (in front of zone 2's front-left corner) first.
